༄༅/ /sngon 'gro sems sbyong bdun gyi don khrid bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: don khrid bzhugs so/ / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la/ /sgo gsum gus pas rab tu phyag 'tshal te/ /mngon sum snying po'i don la 'jug pa'i thabs/ /sems sbyong bdun gyi don khrid gsal bar bya/ /de la skal ldan las dang po pa rnams rig pa mngon sum gyi don la rim gyis 'jug par bya ba'i don du/ rin po che zangs kyi yi ge can las/ sems sbyaung rnam pa bdun du gsungs pa rnams nyams su blang ba'i thabs la bdun las/ dang po mi rtag pa la bsam ste sems sbyong ba ni/ phyi nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog /nyin mtshan skad cig thang cig gis kyang mi rtag pa dang*/ nang 'byung bzhi'i phung po 'gyur ldog chu'i lbu ba spungs pa dang 'dra ba myur du 'jig cing snying po med pas kyang mi rtag pa dang*/ gsang ba pha ma gnyen 'dun shi bas kyang mi rtag pa dang*/ rang la'ang de lta bu'i gnas skabs nam 'byung na ang*/ de ring sang tsam la'ang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng med de/ do nub 'chi'am sang 'chi'am snyam du snying nas skad cig kyang ma yengs par bsam zhing*/ sems can gzhan mthong ba la'ang 'di kun kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das so/ /nam 'chi'am snyam du bsgom pa'o/ /des ni 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin/ mi rtag pa'i dpe mthong nas blo sna thung du song ba ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do/ /de ltar bsgoms pas 'khor ba las blo ldog pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa 'phral gyi bde ba dang yun gyi bde ba la bsam ste sems sbyong pa ni/ las mi dge bas ngan song dang sdug bsngal gyi rigs thams cad bskyed la/ dge bas mtho ris dang bde ba'i rigs pa thams cad bskyed cing*/ 'khor ba mtho dman gyi rang bzhin zo chu'i 'khyud mo 'dra ba/ 'pho zhing rtag mi thub pa 'di mtshangs re che/ 'khor bar mi 'jug pa'i thabs dam pa/ thar pa'i byang chub ma gtogs par yid brtan mi rung zhing bslu ba 'di ya cha/ thar pa'i lam du zhugs na 'phral gyi bde ba mtho ris dang*/

yon tan bzang po rgyud la 'thob ste/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhin yun gyi bde ba bla na med pa'i byang chub 'grub ste sangs rgyas rnams bzhin no/ /de bas na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub par bya snyam du bsam mo/ /des na thar pa'i lam du ma tshud na/ mi dge bas ngan song*/ dge ba byas pas mtho ris su skyes kyang*/ slar ngan song du 'khor ba'i phyir/ byas pa thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'dug ang snyam pa snying nas byung ba ni goms pa'i tshad do/ /des ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las yid dbyung nas skyo shas drag po rgyud la skye ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / gsum pa rkyen du ma la bsam ste sems sbyong ba ni/ 'khor bar skyes dus na yid brtan dang blo gtad mi 'dug ste/ phan btags kyang phan lan du gnod pa bskyel ba dang*/ zas skom zos kyang nad dang 'chi rkyen du 'gro ba dang*/ yo byad bsags kyang dgra rkun gyi 'dod pa sgrub pa dang*/ phan du re nas gnyen bshes su btags pas gnod pa'i dgrar 'gyur ba dang*/ gnod pa ma byas kyang don med pa'i ngan smras dang skur par 'gyur ba dang*/ gang byas kyang gzhan gyi yid mi mgu ba dang*/ zan pa'i dus med pa 'di mtshangs re che/ sems can gyi bsam spyod la snying nas bsam na gong ltar phan btags kyang*/ la la mgu dus la la mi mgu/ ji ltar bsams kyang mtha' gcig tu phan med/ ci byas thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ nad rkyen dang 'chi rkyen grangs mang ba 'di dag la dngos su phan pa mi 'grub pas/ blo ltos mi bslu bar bla ma dkon mchog las gzhan med pa'i phyir mos gus dang mchod pa byas na 'di phyir bde ba'i rgyu yin pas/ blo sna dge ba 'ba' zhig la bsgyur dgos snyam du rkyen bzang ngan sngar byung ba dang*/ da lta byed pa dang*/ phyis byed 'gyur rnams la bsam zhing*/ skyo shas dang blo sna bstung bar bya'o/

/ des na rigs drug gi sems can rnams la snying rje skye zhing*/ las su dkon mchog dang*/ bla ma mchod na ci ma rung snyam pa ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do/ /des ni dad pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /bzhi pa byas pa thams cad don med pa la sems skyong ba ni/ bdag gis tshe 'di'i bya bzhag gnyen skyong ba/ dgra 'dul ba/ so nam zhib tig /tshong khe spog khe drag lo 'dod/ chags sdang*/ zhe sdang*/ gzhan gyis sha tsha gros 'debs/ che thabs dang*/ gtam snyan 'dod pa la sogs pa nas/ gnyen grogs dang lhan cig longs spyod dang bshes 'dris/ gnas khyim mkhar len la sogs pa ci dang ci byas kyang shi ba'i nangs par 'grogs nas mi 'gro bas phan med do/ khar sang phan chad kyi bya byed ci dang ci byas dran pa'i yul tsam las phyir mi 'ong bas mdang gi rmi lam dang 'dra/ de ring gi snang ba do nub kyi rmi lam dang 'dra/ sang phan chad byed pa rnams kyang sang dgong kyi rmi lam dang 'dra ba zhig yin par 'dug pa la/ don med pa'i chags sdang dang*/ 'thab rtsod/ snyan mi snyan/ bde sdug bsog 'jog bya byed rnam pa sna tshogs pa gcig gis dus 'das pa 'di mtshangs re che/ 'jig rten gyi snang ba sgyu ma'i bslu brid du 'dug pa/ de ring las ma rtogs pas lings kyis blos btang la/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gcig rgyud la nyams su blang dgos snyam du bsam mo/ /des na snang ba gang la'ang blo gtad med par/ bla ma'i gdams ngag cig thob par bya dgos snyam pa dung gis byung ba ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do/ /des ni bla ma'i gdams ngag la 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /lnga pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la brten nas sems sbyong ba ni/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa thams cad las 'das pa ni sangs rgyas te/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad du 'bar ba/ gsung chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ thugs ye shes kyi ngang las mi g.yo ba/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dren pa dam pa gtso bo gcig pu skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa yin pas thob par bya dgos/

sangs ma rgyas na phan mi 'dug sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la'ang lam ma bsgoms na mi thob pas/ cis kyang bsgom dgos/ grub thob gong ma ngo mtshar can rnams kyi rjes bsnyegs la sgrub pa rtse gcig tu bya dgos/ khong rnams pas dka' ba du ma spyad/ gcig pur dben par bsgoms pas grol ba ltar bdag gis kyang tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang la gcig pur dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub dgos snyam du bsam mo/ /des na ma bsgoms na sangs mi rgya bas/ cis kyang sgom dgos snyam pa rgyud la skyes pa ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do/ /des ni sgom pa la bsran tshugs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /drug pa/ bla ma'i gdams ngag la bsam ste sems sbyong ba ni/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa las sgrol ba'i ded dpon ni bla ma yin la/ sgrol byed thabs kyi gru bo che ni bla ma'i gdams ngag yin pas/ ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du nyams su blang dgos te/ ma blang na sdug bsngal gyi nad kyis gtan du gdungs pa'i phyir na/ bla ma sman pa'-i rgyal po ni brtse ba chen po ste/ gdams ngag sman gyi bdud rtsi la nyin mtshan bsran tshugs par byas la/ nyams su blang dgos snyam nas rgyu mtshan du ma la bsam ste bsgoms pas/ tshe 'di'i bya bas ci bya/ bla ma'i gdams ngag kho na nyams su blang dgos snyam pa ni 'byongs pa'i tshad de/ des ni bya ba gzhan la blo mi 'jug par gdams ngag la rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /bdun pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa la bsam ste sems sbyong ba ni gsum las/ bde stong mi rtog pa la sems sbyong ba ni/ dbu ma'i yar sne'i haṃ las lta ba'i a las me 'bar ba reg pas bdud rtsi babs nas/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi dang rtsa phran thams cad khyab pas bde stong skyes par bsam ste/ 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung mnan zhing snying kar a dkar po la sems bzung bas/ bde bas thabs byas pa'i shes rab stong pa skye'o/ /gsal stong mi rtog pa la sems sbyong ba ni/

rlung ro gsum bus nas/ nang du rdub dus phyi'i snang yul thams cad 'od du zhu nas nam mkha' sngon po dang 'dres pa de rang gi lus nang du byung bas mer mer khengs par sgom pa rlung kha sbyar te bzung bas gsal stong skye'o/ /de'ang grang shas che na rlung de tsha ba/ tsha shas che na bsil ba'i reg bya yod par bsgom pa ni gnad do/ /de'ang dbyar me/ ston rlung*/ dgun chu/ dpyid sa'i rlung rgyu bas de dag gi gnyen po'i rlung dang*/ kha dog dang reg bya sgom tshul du ma bshad kyang spros pa tsam mo/ /nam mkha'i rlung ni kun gyi dus na shis la reg bya'ang gnyis po der 'dus pas nyams su blang ba la 'di tsam kho nas chog go /chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa la sems sbyong ba ni/ lus sems khong glod/ mig mi 'gul bar dran bsam 'phro 'du'i rtog pa dang bral ba'i ngang la bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas sems gar gtad du zin pa'i rjes la/ rtog med nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du yun je ring la gnas pa ni/ rang rang gi goms pa'i tshad do/ /des ni byang chub kyi sems gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /de ltar yang zab sngon du 'gro ba'i gnad/ /sems sbyong bdun gyi don khrid bkod pa las/ byung ba'i dge ba gangs ri ltar dkar bas/ /ma lus 'gro ba nyer zhi'i gnas thob shog /skye ba sngon nas sbyangs pa'i 'phro yod pas/ /tshe 'dir theg mchog snying po'i don la mkhas/ /de phyir gzhan la phan pa'i blo gros kyis/ /zab don mngon phyung gsal bar bkod pa yin/ /snying po'i don zab 'jug ngogs bzang po 'di/ /skal ldan rnams kyis gtsug gi rgyan bzhin zung*/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi shing rta bzang po'i lam/ /yi ge 'di las myur du 'grub pa yin/ /sngon 'gro sems sbyong bdun gyi don khrid/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so//

//dpal sngags kyi bdag mo dang*/ gza' dang*/ dam can gsum la gtad pa yin pas/ yi ge 'dra min bslad pa dang*/ 'chos pa byung na chad pa drag po phob cig snod min la gsang zhig /skal ldan la byin cig kha tham/ sa ma yaḥ sa ma yaḥ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9)sngon 'gro sems sbyong bdun gyi don khrid/ - PAGE 186 -- PAGE 191 -- PAGE 185 -
